title: Handley Page Halifax BB216
memorial_details:
description: Stone: (405 Squadron RCAF badge)/ Just before Midnight/ on 1st September 1942/ HALIFAX II BB216 (LQ-D)/ of 405 Squadron RCAF/ from Topcliffe/ crashed near this spot/ following a disastrous engine fire/ This memorial is placed here to/ commemorate the crew members who died/ (names)

Plinth: IN GRATEFUL REMEMBRANCE

Planter plagues: (405 Squadron RCAF badge)/ THEY WILL/ NEVER GROW/ OLD

Vase: RAOB
